user.title: Vacuum Water Monitor
user.description: Sets the default low-water warning thresholds. After setup, add each vacuum from the integration's Configure menu.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed.

add_vacuum.title: Add a vacuum
add_vacuum.description: Pick a vacuum entity to start tracking water usage for.

select_brand.title: Brand
select_brand.description: Pick the brand for {entity_id}. If a confident guess was possible it's pre-selected — otherwise pick 'Other / not listed' to enter capacity manually.

select_model.title: Model
select_model.description: Pick the {brand} model, or 'Other / custom capacity' to enter capacity manually.

custom_capacity.title: Tank capacity
custom_capacity.description: Enter the mop water tank capacity in mL for this vacuum.

remove_vacuum.title: Stop tracking a vacuum
remove_vacuum.description: This removes the vacuum's water-tracking entities and discards its tank history.

abort.no_new_vacuums: Every vacuum entity in Home Assistant is already tracked.
abort.no_tracked_vacuums: No vacuums are currently tracked — add one first.
